items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: That was at, uh, Leicester Mapp's place.

ctx.x: Were there any other people who were playing that kind of music?
No. Still, the Prod and them had the best band around there at the right time. That was at, uh, Leicester Mapp's place.
Was that in the city of San Francisco?
